mode: Ten abstract plants and eight independent zombies (212..219). Nuclear Shroom replaces native Doom-shroom: five full-board green explosions, a persistent 3x3 crater, 250 sun and a 30-second planting recharge. Adventure and sandbox share the same replacement. Other combat, progression and saves are preserved.
almanacCopy: All ten original plants and eight original zombies show explicit numeric statistics separately from surreal character-specific flavour text. Native cost/recharge footer and full supplemental Chinese glyphs.

nukeShroom.name: 核爆菇
nukeShroom.damage: Native ApplyBurn per pulse (1800), enemies on the board only
nukeShroom.art: Native rig with animated green energy veins and green native mushroom clouds; mild green screen wash. Nine cells form one large crater, including at board edges.
nukeShroom.save: Remaining pulses and crater lifetime use portable native GridItem fields
nukeShroom.nativeRules: Daytime sleep, coffee awakening and detonation windup preserved

tinyPuff.name: 真·小喷菇
tinyPuff.layout: centre, bottom-left, bottom-right, left, right; stable independent poses
tinyPuff.nativeRules: short range, attack cadence and daytime sleep preserved

coneVariants.art: Original cone textures and native hat bone. Green preserves white bands, outlines and all damage stages. Tower nests twenty cones, losing one per 370 armor damage; bottom cone stays registered to the original head. Scoped visuals preserve ordinary zombies.
coneVariants.font: 雪糕桶包裹我 name unchanged. Missing 裹, 叠 and 绿 use complete CoreText STKaiti glyph outlines, rasterized to existing bitmap font ink bounds, advance, baseline and colour. No assembled radicals.

cleverZombies.slowMotion: 1.6 seconds per flip. The middle 0.8 seconds covers 16% of rotation and travel. C1-continuous takeoff/landing; one local progress curve drives rotation, horizontal travel, lane interpolation and height. Other entities and game clocks keep normal speed. Legacy mid-flight saves complete their original 90-tick trajectory.
cleverZombies.animation: Generated smug face without glasses; an angular jaw with prominent crease marks appears on flips, lane changes and steals. Shared skull registration on the native head bone; original body, cone and duck ring. Two-tile flight follows a continuous slow-motion arc. No global time scaling. Carries the stolen native plant frame. No bucket variant.

cactusPalm.art: Opaque wrist (6,29) registers inside native lip opening (5,13.5), drawn over its dark fill. Original mouth connector and lip images are retained; previews and projectile launch share that exact attachment transform. Existing generated asset, no redraw.

giantImp.art: Native imp rig and body; native giant head and independent jaw share one neck anchor and hinged jaw strike. Scoped transforms preserve ordinary imps, giant-carried imps, previews and death art.
giantImp.spawn: First eligible ordinary land-lane entry in waves 2,6,10,...; never converts native or thrown imps.
giantImp.attack: Kills the current native melee target at impact, with a visible windup/recovery and normal freeze, targeting and plant-interaction gates. No area kill, extra armor, throwing or knockback.

smallNut.art: Original wall-nut rig, blink and two damaged faces, scaled around the same ground anchor with a smaller shadow. Passive blocking only; no bite.

coneWrapZombie.name: 雪糕桶包裹我
coneWrapZombie.art: Exactly twenty native cones form the entire character. All anatomical and clothing textures are replaced, including zero armor, portraits and burn/death. Original cone damage textures and draw-only bone scopes. No external art.

tuckingProduction: Tucked sunflowers pause their native production countdown and cannot spawn suns. Standing resumes the exact remaining time, including save/resume; each sun stays worth 25 and the standing production rate is unchanged.
tuckingPoolSupport: Standing and tucked sunflowers in pool squares disappear after losing their last living lily pad, including unsupported flowers restored from old saves. Land and lifted plants are unchanged.
mobileTextInput: Tappable native-widget overlay inside the fullscreen canvas container, with IME composition, native text/width limits, selection, deletion and ordered submit. Desktop keyboard behavior is unchanged.
